about: Words that make a prompt or a file name clearly sexual (U13, U82). parts match anywhere, words only as whole words (camelCase split). A prompt or file name with one is rated Adult (SNAP-R39) and a LoRA named with one is tagged nsfw by onboarding; borderline words never rate or tag anything, they are listed for the person to decide. A person's own snap/nsfw_terms.json adds to these.
